decision_rules.highest_posterior_harms_forecast: paired highest-posterior-minus-posterior-weighted squared-error 95% interval lower bound is above zero
decision_rules.highest_posterior_improves_forecast: paired highest-posterior-minus-posterior-weighted squared-error 95% interval upper bound is below zero
decision_rules.retain_as_method_candidate: at least one lead improves and no other lead harms

hypotheses.context_methods: Full-interaction updating, uniform independent-candidate averaging, and the known-true candidate are descriptive references.
hypotheses.negative_results_reported: Report improvement, harm, or no detectable difference separately at 1, 3, and 7 days; retain the selection rule only if at least one lead improves and no lead harms.
hypotheses.primary_question: At each lead, does selecting the highest final posterior candidate after no-state-interaction assimilation improve forecast accuracy relative to posterior-weighted averaging?
hypotheses.shared_computation: Highest-posterior selection and posterior-weighted averaging use the exact same no-state-interaction assimilation and candidate forecasts; only the final combination rule differs.
